name: Route
description: Exposes an HTTP endpoint on the board's webserver. Declares input schema to generate typed board variables.

inputs.name: responseMode
inputs.label: Response Mode

options.label: Synchronous (Wait for Response / HTTP Response block)

inputs.helpText: Synchronous returns the output from downstream HTTP Response block. Asynchronous returns 202 immediately.

inputs.name: type
inputs.label: Request Body Schema (Zod)
inputs.helpText: Zod or TypeScript schema for the request body (POST/PUT/PATCH). Properties become typed variables under body.*

inputs.name: querySchema
inputs.label: Query Parameters Schema (Zod)
inputs.helpText: Zod or TypeScript schema for URL query string parameters (?key=val). Declared properties become typed variables under query.*

inputs.name: paramsSchema
inputs.label: URL Parameters Schema (Zod)
inputs.helpText: Zod or TypeScript schema for URL path parameters (e.g. /users/:id). Declared properties become typed variables under params.*
